title: World editor reopen fix is not yet verified on a real iPhone
reproduction: Confirm Kelo Studio appears and is interactive.
Close/remove the Studio shell or reproduce the stale-session condition.
Open Create -> World again and confirm Studio remounts instead of black-screening.
expected: World opens, remains interactive, and can be reopened even after a stale Studio shell/session condition.
actual: Fixes for stale Studio state and blocking IndexedDB exist in main, but real-iPhone acceptance remains unproven because BrowserStack fails before the page can be exercised.
evidence: Commit 829ac7fbd5fc629b05ecf92489bab16b0292bce9: fix(studio): keep World editor responsive when IndexedDB hangs (#222)
tests/world-editor-ios-reopen.spec.js covers stale Studio shell recovery
BrowserStack real-iPhone runs currently fail during browser context creation before validating World
owner_hint: Kelo Creators / World workspace + Kelo Studio storage/session lifecycle

fix.summary: World launch/studio storage now attempts bounded IndexedDB waits, fail-open behavior and stale Studio-session recovery instead of leaving the UI blocked indefinitely.

verification.method: Real iPhone Safari E2E: enter game -> Create -> World -> interact/place -> close -> reopen -> no black screen.

notes: Visibility of #kelo-studio-live alone is not sufficient acceptance; the editor must respond to touch/placement and reopen successfully.
Do not mark VERIFIED until the deployed flow passes on the target device class.
